title: Let gratitude break the self open
subtitle: For importance that has forgotten mercy
description: The shabad names ego as disease and grace as cure. These readings let gratitude expose what self-importance cannot heal.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Haumai is disease; the Lord’s grace and Shabad become the medicine within it.
heroSource.lifeApplication: When importance rises, thank the mercy you did not manufacture.

evidence.coreClaim: This path breaks ego by making received mercy impossible to ignore.
evidence.turn: Gratitude is not politeness here; it is the cure that punctures self-authorship.
evidence.practicalImplication: Name one gift you did not earn and let it lower the tone of your next action.
